payload.blocks: Phase 8 (question relay measure) and phase 10 after it; phases 2, 5, 6, 9 and 11's other work continue.
payload.headline: Widen the heads-stable footprint by observe-kinds.json so the secretary can record question relays?

parts.cause: packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json is a strict registry and declares only fgos.coordination.act (attrs act, from, to, outcome). An undeclared kind or attr is refused, so the new record would fail. The file is outside this plan's footprint; the plan assumed any fgos.coordination.* kind was accepted.

options.cost: One footprint line and a small unit.
options.does: Supervisor adds packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json to the footprint; phase 8 declares the kind fgos.coordination.question-relayed with attrs questionId, askedAt, relayedAt (session subject), prunable like coordination.act.
options.gain: The measure works as planned, from records, and phase 10 can reuse it.
options.harm: One more shared contract file in this plan.
options.label: Widen footprint by observe-kinds.json

options.does: Drop the record; phase 8 measures seen-time from the commit time of the secretary's report or batch file that names each question id.
options.gain: No new kind or footprint change.
options.harm: Depends on her reports naming ids and being landed promptly; a chat-only relay is invisible.
options.label: Measure from secretary report commits

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by observe-kinds.json: it keeps the planned measure on records, at the cost of one footprint line.

scope.allows: Adding packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json to this plan's footprint and declaring the one record kind phase 8 needs.
scope.forbids: Any other kind, attr or footprint change, and any change to the other phases.

parts.what: Phase 8 asks the secretary to record one fgos.coordination.question-relayed record per relayed owner question with metrics record, so ask-to-seen time can be measured. The skill text is written (branch heads-stable-and-able/p08).
